observation: The P0v7 local one-use claim directory cannot prove that every Kaggle saved notebook version is represented, so a scientific cell could be consumed through an unrecorded version. The vectorized secondary policy selector also needed an independent retained scalar reference before its performance improvement could be relied upon. No P0v7 upload, market archive, market outcome, scientific cell, protected outcome or saved-version scientific claim had occurred.
hypothesized_cause: Local filesystem receipts describe only local writes, while Kaggle saved versions are an external append-only execution surface. Vectorization changes implementation structure and requires a differential reference contract even when the optimization target is unchanged.
change: Freeze P0v8 as an evidence-contract-only amendment. Require a complete external Kaggle saved-version ledger with unique search/fixed claims before scientific cells, expose a fail-closed audit command, retain the currently incomplete ledger as negative admission evidence, and require regression equality between the vectorized policy selector and a scalar reference selector. Repackage as version 0.1.5 without changing model, cells, controls, thresholds, inference or budgets.
predicted_effect: An incomplete or duplicate external saved-version inventory will block scientific execution, and a vectorization-induced action-selection difference will fail the engineering gate before it can affect a scientific cell.
discriminating_experiment: Run complete warning-strict tests including duplicate-ledger and randomized scalar-versus-vector policy cases; pass source/test Ruff, formatting and strict mypy; update the lock; build two fixed-epoch wheels byte-identically; install the exact wheel into a clean target; and demonstrate that the incomplete retained ledger fails closed.
